news.title: Indian IPO market clocks record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, fundraising jumps 30%
news.summary: India's mainboard IPO market raised a record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, up 30% year-on-year, as September saw unprecedented fundraising. Strong investor participation, confidential filings and a robust pipeline supported primary market momentum.

news.title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far
news.summary: Foreign institutional investors raised their stakes in 19 Nifty 50 companies in the September 2026 quarter. Of these, 11 stocks have gained 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, reflecting strong price momentum alongside increased FII ownership.

news.title: MobiKwik shares zoom 10% as fintech firm posts record Rs 12 crore profit in Q2
news.summary: MobiKwik returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, reporting a record consolidated net profit of Rs 11.8 crore against a loss of Rs 28.6 crore a year earlier. Profit rose over 55% sequentially from Rs 7.6 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations increased 9% year-on-year to Rs 1,082.6 crore.

news.title: South Eastern Coalfields files DRHP with SEBI for IPO; Coal India to offload 66.8 crore shares
news.summary: Coal India subsidiary South Eastern Coalfields has filed its draft papers with SEBI for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of up to 66.81 crore shares. One of India’s largest coal producers, SECL reported higher revenue and profit and plans to list on the BSE and NSE.

news.title: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low
news.summary: Gold has fallen more than 30% from its January record high, with rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of further Fed rate hikes adding to pressure. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, even as major banks retain bullish forecasts for 2027.

news.title: Nasdaq Outlook: Is the worst over for AI-fuelled tech stocks?
news.summary: Wall Street’s AI-led rally faced a sharp setback as the Nasdaq recorded its biggest single-day fall since June. Heavy losses in technology stocks reflected growing investor concerns over hyperscaler spending and the returns on artificial intelligence investments.

news.title: Coal India shares jump 4% after firm records highest-ever monthly coal supplies in October
news.summary: Coal India shares jumped more than 4% after the state-run miner reported record monthly coal production and supplies in October. Total supplies crossed 70 million tonnes for the first time, while deliveries to the power sector reached an all-time high of 57.1 million tonnes.

news.title: Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan Overweight on NSE shares, see up to 30% upside potential; Check target price
news.summary: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan initiated coverage of NSE with Overweight ratings, citing rising retail investment, market dominance and growth potential. They set price targets of ₹2,315 and ₹2,130, while warning that regulation, weaker activity,competition in index options could constrain returns.
